description: This Java class 'BinaryProtocol' facilitates communication with a hardware controller using a binary protocol. It manages establishing connection, reading and writing configuration data, switching protocols, handling packet transmission with CRC validation, and executing commands with the device. The class is integral to the firmware interface, providing low-level interaction with hardware components in the project.

classes.name: BinaryProtocol
classes.description: A class managing low-level communication with a hardware controller via binary protocol, including connection, data transfer, command execution, and protocol switching.

methods.name: connectAndReadConfiguration
methods.description: Establishes connection with the hardware controller, switches to binary protocol, reads the device configuration, and starts a data listener thread.

methods.name: uploadChanges
methods.description: Uploads modified configuration data to the device, comparing current and new configurations and applying necessary patches.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the communication stream and marks the connection as closed.

methods.name: writeData
methods.description: Sends data chunks to the device, handling large data by splitting into multiple packets.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Sends a binary command packet to the device and waits for a response, returning the response bytes.

methods.name: requestPendingMessages
methods.description: Requests pending messages or data from the controller.

methods.name: requestOutputChannels
methods.description: Requests and updates the current output channels and sensor values from the device.
